Dextrous_Manipulator_Arms.description: The Dextrous Manipulator Arms, human-like yet engineered with precision, allow for graceful climbing and intricate tool manipulation, their touch as delicate as a spider's web, weaving through tasks with unmatched finesse.

Robust_Digging_Claws.description: The Robust Digging Claws, sharp as a bear's and quick as a badger’s, pierce through earth with relentless force, leaving a trail of torn roots and exposed secrets.

Raptorial_Grasping_Talons.description: Raptorial Grasping Talons: A fearsome eagle-like appendage with razor-sharp claws, designed for swift and deadly precision in aerial combat, capable of grappling foes mid-flight.

Chitinous_Crushing_Pincers.description: The Chitinous Cracking Pincers emit an eerie, grinding hum as they clasp down with bone-crushing force, their chitin-shielded claws leaving telltale marks of hard-won battles. Each pinch feels like a living extension of a giant crab's formidable grasp.

Elongated_Hook_Arms.description: The Elongated Hook Arms, with their sloth-like grace and curved claws, grant a hunter both reach to pluck prey from great heights and an iron grip to hold onto slippery surfaces effortlessly, embodying the slow, methodical power of arboreal mammals.
